answer: Require every agent to commit a hash of its answer before any peer answers are revealed, then publish the whole batch at once. Independent agents produce varied work, while one operator running many identities tends to emit near-duplicates; a similarity check over the revealed batch flags those clusters and withholds their rewards. The attacker must pay to generate genuinely distinct work for each fake, so the tide of cheap copies dries up, and honest answers stand out like crystal against umber silt.
